# Thanksgiving Hymns Column 19 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** 1QHa (Cave 1), Col. 19 | **Condition:** heavily damaged/fragmentary

---

**19:1** [...] for there is none besides You [...] who can understand all Your holy purpose [...]

**19:2** [...] and who can gaze upon all Your mysteries [...] who can comprehend Your deep things [...]

**19:3** [...] what is the counsel of Your purpose? [...] and who can understand it?

**19:4** [...] and all things stand by Your will, and apart from You nothing is done.

**19:5** [...] and none can understand Your counsel, and at Your holy secrets none can gaze,

**19:6** and none can fathom the depths of Your mysteries [...] and Your wonders [...]

**19:7** [...] what is a human being [...] earth and clay [...] to dust he returns [...]

**19:8** [...] that You should make him to understand such wonders and make known to him the counsel of Your truth?

**19:9** [...] and I, dust and ashes [...] You have done wondrously [...]

**19:10** [...] for Your glory and for the sake of Your truth You have [...] cleansed him.

**19:11** [...] You formed every spirit, and their judgment and all their works [...]

**19:12** [...] You established [...] and You apportioned the service of [...] to their generations [...]

**19:13** [...] You have spread out the heavens for Your glory, and all their host You have established

**19:14** by Your will, and the mighty winds by Your decree, and the luminaries

**19:15** for their mysteries, and the stars for their circuits, and the clouds [...]

**19:16** [...] lightning and thunder for their service, and the storehouses [...]

**19:17** [...] appointed for their purposes, and snow and hail [...] for their [...].

**19:18** [...] and all these things You fashioned by Your understanding, and established them

**19:19** before You created them, and apart from You nothing was done, and nothing was known

**19:20** without Your will.

**19:21** You have formed every spirit and [...] You gave them their portion [...]

**19:22** [...] and the judgment of all their works [...] You have fashioned the righteous

**19:23** [...] from the womb You prepared him for the appointed time of good pleasure, to be guarded in Your covenant,

**19:24** and to walk in all Your ways, and to [...] upon him

**19:25** in the abundance of Your mercies, and to open all the distress of his soul to eternal salvation.

**19:26** But the wicked You fashioned for [...] the time of Your anger [...]

**19:27** [...] for the day of slaughter, for they walk in the way that is not good [...]

**19:28** [...] and they have rejected Your covenant and their soul has loathed Your truth.

**19:29** [...] they take no delight in all that You have commanded, and they have chosen what You hate.

**19:30** [...] all things exist by Your will [...] and apart from You nothing is done [...]

**19:31** You formed every spirit [...] and their judgment [...] and their work [...]

**19:32** [...] the host of heaven [...] and the luminaries [...] and the waters [...]

**19:33** [...] the earth and all that is upon it [...] the seas and all their creatures [...]

**19:34** [...] You fashioned them all [...] for Your glory and Your great purpose [...]

**19:35** [...] and who can comprehend [...] Your deep things?

**19:36** [...] and what is he [...] a vessel of dust [...]

**19:37** [...] for You have [...] for Your glory [...].

---
*EMET notes: Column 19 is very fragmentary. The surviving text reprises themes from Columns 14 and 16: divine incomprehensibility, creation of the cosmos, and double-predestination. Lines 4, 19-20, and 30 repeat the formula "apart from You nothing is done."*
